title: Credence
tagline: Credence is a revolutionary decentralized pollin authentic, bot-free community insights.
description:
Credence is a revolutionary decentralized polling and survey platform built on the Celo blockchain that combines privacy-preserving identity verification with tokenized incentives to create authentic, bot-free community insights.
Key Features:
Privacy-First Verification

Integrates Self Protocol's zero-knowledge proof system for identity verification
Users prove they're human without revealing personal information
No data leaves the user's device during verification
how_its_made:
Built on Celo for low-cost, accessible transactions
Smart contracts ensure transparent reward distribution
Immutable poll results and participation records

🎯 Use Cases:

Market research with verified demographics
Community governance voting
Academic research surveys
Product feedback collection
Social sentiment analysis

Technical Architecture:
Frontend: Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
Blockchain: Celo Sepolia testnet with Solidity smart contracts
Identity: Self Protocol for zero-knowledge verification
Wallet Integration: RainbowKit for seamless Web3 onboarding
Storage: Decentralized storage for poll metadata
